_about: Curated project imagery. Source files come from the studio's Google Drive folder 'MARKETING & BRANDING'. Each project follows the brand kit's three kinds of picture: Space, Material, Whole. Run scripts/media/export.cjs to regenerate the web files in public/images/projects.
